from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess
base="9f4fc0dc71aea493bd2a5826b0e7c66078cd3c63"
head="0b667a64d15deca4b81a116e8c78d9541a40129d"
def git(*args): return subprocess.check_output(["git",*args])
assert git("rev-parse","HEAD").decode().strip()==head
paths=["web/tests/e2e/run.mjs","web/scripts/ui-diagnostic-ack.test.mjs","api/tests/test_web_e2e.py","contracts/omnis.openapi.json","web/tests/e2e/b04.mjs","web/tests/e2e/leaks.mjs"]
manifest=[]
for path in paths:
    candidate=git("show",head+":"+path)
    assert Path(path).read_bytes()==candidate, path
    row={"path":path,"candidate_blob":git("rev-parse",head+":"+path).decode().strip(),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(candidate).hexdigest(),"working_bytes_match_candidate":True}
    if path!="web/scripts/ui-diagnostic-ack.test.mjs":
        baseline=git("show",base+":"+path)
        row["base_blob"]=git("rev-parse",base+":"+path).decode().strip()
        row["unchanged_from_base"]=candidate==baseline
    manifest.append(row)
old=b"    const ack = await response.json();"
current=Path(paths[0]).read_bytes()
new="\n".join(current.decode().splitlines()[141:145]).encode()
assert new.startswith(b"    let body;\n    try { body = await response.body(); }")
assert b"TRANSPORT_UNCONFIRMED" in new and b"JSON.parse(body.toString(" in new
assert current.count(new)==1
restored=current.replace(new,old)
assert restored==git("show",base+":"+paths[0])
assert hashlib.sha256(restored).hexdigest()=="583adc2427cac0b74db8584a47572c79ecd03e740329858d164f76b30a99735a"
diff=git("diff","--no-ext-diff","--no-renames",base,head,"--",paths[0],paths[1])
changed=git("diff","--name-only",base,head).decode().splitlines()
assert sorted(changed)==sorted(paths[:2])
print(json.dumps({"base":base,"candidate":head,"files":manifest,"restored_driver_sha256":hashlib.sha256(restored).hexdigest(),"only_driver_change_is_four_line_body_parse_seam":True,"changed_paths":changed,"scoped_diff_sha256":hashlib.sha256(diff).hexdigest()},indent=2))
